caption: The drawing shows five distinct objects arranged horizontally on a cream-colored background. On the left, there is a round, gold pocket watch with a decorative, symmetrical top loop resembling a fleur-de-lis. The watch face is white with black numerals and two ornate black hands, showing the time at 8:53. To the right of the watch is a circular gold back cover with intricate floral and star patterns engraved on it. Further to the right is a depiction of the watch's internal mechanism, rendered in grey, gold, and black tones, and inscribed along the edge with the text "Illinois Watch Co Springfield Ill." Below these three objects are two outline sketches; the one on the left labeled "FRONT EXACT SIZE" is a simple circle, and the one on the right labeled "THICK EXACT SIZE" is a corresponding profile view of the same circle, depicted as a thin vertical line.
title: Lady's Watch Case and Frame
